Each module is {{< var workshop.lecture_minutes >}} minutes of lecture followed by {{< var workshop.lab_minutes >}} minutes of lab. The capstone on Day 4 takes the whole afternoon.

Day 1 opens the room at 08:00 for an optional self-serve hour, [Module 0 · {{< var modules.m00.title >}}](lectures/00-coding-agents.qmd). You work through its page on your own: there is no talk and no notebook, and you can do it beforehand as pre-work instead. The workshop proper starts at 09:00.
